description: Lists what can be made from a report the person may read: each maker (a slide deck, a document) with the parts it can make from, such as the boards of a design, each with its `ref` to send to make_report, its label and the design page it is on, plus the title a made report gets when none is given. A report with nothing to make from (no boards) lists no makers. Read it before make_report.

report_id.description: The report to make from (list_reports gives ids).

version.description: The version to read the parts from. Leave it out for the newest.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_report_makers
title: List what can be made from a report
